verdict.rationale: The quickstart offers a no-key, no-install Cloud Console playground and runnable code snippets such as the SDK install and a first API call, which gives some hands-on exploration. However, there is no evidence of an interactive API reference with try-it-out endpoints, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Missing for 10: an interactive per-endpoint API reference, in-docs try-it execution, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.
